notes.ssenga: Literally “father’s mother-sister”; in Teso the aunt also guides the bride.

tips.title: Kilakara!
body: **Kilakara!** (be happy!) is congratulations; **Kilakarata oni!** “let’s celebrate!”. **Ailip** is a celebration or dance, **ainakinet** a gift.

tips.title: Amina koni
body: **Amina koni…** is “I wish you…”. **Akoloŋit ka akidouni ejokan!** is happy birthday (good day of birth). **Eyalama kanuka abunore** thanks people for coming.

culture.title: Bride wealth
body: In Teso a marriage is sealed by the groom’s family giving cattle to the bride’s family. The introduction, **akitodiaar**, is where the families meet and agree.
